title: What Is the Difference Between Poet and Speaker?
skills: distinguish the poet from the speaker of a poem
analyze the speaker's perspective and voice
avoid assuming the speaker represents the author's personal beliefs
support interpretations of speaker and voice with textual evidence
alignment_note: Explains the distinction between the poet as the author and the speaker as the voice presented within a poem. Supports poetry analysis, point-of-view interpretation, author-speaker distinction, and evidence-based discussion of poetic voice across high school English courses.
